title: Constant values within a part
statement: Let $\mathcal{P}$ be a monochromatic rectangle partition for a function $g : X \to Y \to \alpha$, and let $R \in \mathcal{P}$. Then $g$ is constant on $R$: for any $(x,y), (x',y') \in R$ we have $g\,x\,y = g\,x'\,y'$.
hypotheses_covered: P is a monochromatic rectangle partition for g
R is a member of P
replaced:
If $\mathcal{P}$ is a monochromatic rectangle partition for $g$, $R \in \mathcal{P}$,
and $(x,y), (x',y') \in R$, then $g\,x\,y = g\,x'\,y'$.
